## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run build` and `npm test` pass locally
- [ ] New or changed tools: every parameter has `.describe()`; write tools match `WRITE_TOOLS` and offer `dryRun`
- [ ] Ran `UPDATE_SNAPSHOT=1 npm test` and `npm run docs:sync` if the tool list changed
- [ ] Updated `README.md`, `README.zh-CN.md` and `CHANGELOG.md` (Unreleased) where relevant
- [ ] No real site data, IDs, tokens or emails anywhere in the diff (use `example.com` placeholders)
